digest.component_or_area: quality audit and linting gates (C901, Mypy, Ruff)
propositions: Enable function complexity ratchet (C901) at threshold 15 as shrink-only baseline and integrate into canonical lint gate
Enable four safe Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) after revalidating existing diagnostics
Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families by making three DTZ sites timezone-explicit and creating shared ratchet test
Enable Ruff RUF rule family (excluding RUF001/002/003) by clearing approved RUF100 diagnostics and extending ratchet test
Defer enforcement of disallow_any_generics, disallow_untyped_defs, Ruff security rules, and Semgrep expansion to future phases
All newly-enforced ratchet families must exit zero against current origin/main and resolve pre-existing diagnostics before landing
